newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - S3 off after Q2 outlook.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - S3 off after Q2 outlook.

text.p: Shares in S3 Inc fell before Tuesday's market open in selling driven by the company's forecast of second quarter results falling below those of the first quarter, traders said.
The outlook was made along with with S3's announcement last night of first quarter earnings of $0.30 per share, in-line with Wall Street's view and $0.05 above the year-ago period.
In after-hours trade last night, the shares fell to 9-13/16 from 10-11/16, and contiuned down early Tuesday to 9-1/2, traders said.
